requirements.text: The two 4.5 mm through-hole centers are exactly 96.0 mm apart on flat 18 by 24 by 5 mm mounting pads at Z=0, with no threaded plastic bosses.
No mounting pad or handle material overlaps the drawer-label region below Y=-18 mm.
The handle outer envelope is at most 118 mm wide, 28 mm high and 34 mm proud of the drawer.
At least 25 mm clearance exists between the rear of the grip and drawer plane over the central 65 mm span.
The bow uses a nominal 12 by 9 mm oval grip, internal blends at least 3 mm where space permits, touched-edge rounds at least 1 mm, and a shallow 1.5 mm thumb recess over the central 40 mm.
Source and repaired meshes remain distinct and the final 3MF and support preview bind to the reviewed repaired-mesh revision.
The final slice uses installed P1S 0.4 mm PETG profiles, 0.20 mm layers, five walls and 40% infill without silent material substitution.
A recorded review compares pads-down and side orientations, retains the selected support preview and identifies support-contact locations.
The output set contains source mesh, repaired mesh, support preview, final 3MF and a digest-bound clearly simulated local transfer receipt.
The prototype is not represented as a tested lifting/load-restraint handle or certified/fit-validated part, and no real printer connection or print is performed.
